description: Public collection of high-quality templates created by General Legal attorneys with CC0 license
summary: What caught my eye is the `<mark>` tag convention for fill-in fields — it's a minimal, machine-parseable signal that lets you script a "what still needs customizing?" pass over any template without NLP, which is exactly the kind of low-toil, observable setup I like. The BAA and DPA templates are directly relevant to my bioinformatics work where I'm handling PHI, and the CC0 license means I can drop them into Proreerfolio's onboarding flow or Oh Tidepool's data-processing paperwork without a lawyer review cycle. The whole thing is structured like a small dev tool — one directory per template, a fetch script, a docx-to-markdown converter — rather than a content dump, so it slots cleanly into a pipeline instead of sitting in a shared drive.
